verdict.rationale: Jan can import existing GGUF files from local disk, so models already downloaded for other tools can be used without fetching them again. It is also powered by llama.cpp, which implies a standard, portable format rather than a proprietary conversion. However, the evidence never documents where Jan stores downloaded models or caches, or whether other runtimes can point at them directly. Missing for 10: documented model storage location and layout, explicit statement that Jan-downloaded files are reusable by other runtimes (e.g., Ollama, LM Studio, llama.cpp) without re-conversion, shared-cache or symlink support, independent corroboration.
